summary: Wave 12 RETEST after main-agent fixes. Both blocking bugs from iteration_16 are fully resolved. Re-ran the entire test_wave12.py regression suite (11 tests) — ALL 11 PASS (vs 8/11 last iteration). Added one extra targeted test (test_wave12_pending.py) that signs up a fresh supplier and confirms GET /api/d2d/me does NOT 500 for a pending (un-approved) account — also PASSES with verified=false + reason in {not_supplier|no_supplier_record|not_approved}. Specifically verified: (1) /api/d2d/me as approved supplier → 200 {verified: true, business_name, supplier_id}. (2) /api/d2d/me as customer → {verified: false, reason: 'not_supplier'}. (3) /api/d2d/me as pending supplier → {verified: false, reason: not_approved/no_supplier_record} — no 500. (4) /api/d2d/me unauth → 403. (5) POST /api/supplier/printers without image_url → 200/201 (no longer 422; PrinterListingCreate.image_url confirmed Optional[str]='' at line 1517). (6) All other Wave 12 endpoints still green: /d2d/listings shape + counts, toner/paper creates without image, /supplier/printers PUT d2d body returns 200 or 503 (graceful), /supplier/papers PUT d2d returns 200 or 503, /mps/inquiry bulk_enquiry with company. Wave 12 backend is now 100% green; main agent can proceed with frontend verification of the /dealer 3-section layout for approved suppliers.
